command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== build a staircase-coverage fixture (with a deliberate overlap) ==" 
cat > gen.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{
  L=100
  print "@HD\tVN:1.6\tSO:unsorted"            > "reads.sam"
  print "@SQ\tSN:chr1\tLN:20000"              > "reads.sam"
  seq=""; qual=""
  for(i=0;i<L;i++){ seq=seq "A"; qual=qual "I" }
  # a deliberate staircase with an overlap, so summation is exercised
  # 5 reads at 1000; 2 reads at 2000 and 2 at 2050 (overlap -> depth 4 in the middle); 1 read at 5000
  n=0
  for(j=1;j<=5;j++){ n++; printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n,1000,L,seq,qual > "reads.sam" }
  for(j=1;j<=2;j++){ n++; printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n,2000,L,seq,qual > "reads.sam" }
  for(j=1;j<=2;j++){ n++; printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n,2050,L,seq,qual > "reads.sam" }
  n++; printf "r%d\t0\tchr1\t%d\t60\t%dM\t*\t0\t0\t%s\t%s\n", n,5000,L,seq,qual > "reads.sam"
  printf "reads %d  read_len %d  aligned_bases %d  expected_max_depth 5\n", n, L, n*L
}
AWKEOF
awk -f gen.awk | tee fixture.txt

echo "== sort + index with samtools (deepTools reads BAM, and cannot make one) =="
samtools sort -o reads.bam reads.sam
samtools index reads.bam
samtools view -c reads.bam | awk '{print "bam_records", $1}'

echo "== the coverage profile this fixture MUST produce (0-based, bedgraph) =="
printf '999\t1099\t5\n1999\t2049\t2\n2049\t2099\t4\n2099\t2149\t2\n4999\t5099\t1\n' > expected_cov.txt
cat expected_cov.txt
